title: ⚠️ Weekly Backup ⚠️
message: It is important that you back up your data frequently – at least once a week – as the OS might delete those in case of inactivity. Would you like to export all open tasks now?

alert.sure: You are about to erase all data and restore those you have selected. Are you sure you want to continue?

text: Export a ZIP file to back up all your data and settings, or upload one to restore them.
